title: finding(app-shell): PackageFormDialog's 409 / 403 localized arms still discard a producer-marked `error.userMessage`
body:
## Observation

Found while implementing objectui#7979 (the fourth copy of the ADR-0112 envelope ladder,
in `PackageFormDialog`'s `apiJson`). That card's fix is about the LADDER: the reader now
calls `readEnvelopeFailureText`, so a producer-marked `error.userMessage` and the declared
`error.code` reach the string the dialog throws. This card is about what sits IN FRONT of
that string.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx`'s `submit()` catch has
two status-driven arms ahead of the banner:

```ts
if (e?.status === 409 || /already exists/i.test(msg)) {
  setError(t('engine.packages.create.exists', locale));
} else if (e?.status === 403 || /manage_metadata/i.test(msg)) {
  setError(t('engine.packages.noCapability', locale));
} else {
  setError(msg || t(..., locale));
}
```

On a 409 or a 403 the arm answers with a localized constant and the envelope prose is
discarded — including a producer-marked `userMessage`. Those two statuses are the two most
likely refusals for exactly the surface the ladder card called out: creating a package with
a taken id (409) and saving one without the ADR-0066 capability (403). So after objectui#7979
the mark reaches the author on 4xx/5xx generally, and still does not reach them on the two
statuses an author meets most.

## Why this is a question, not a mechanical fix

The two sides are both deliberate and they point in opposite directions:

- The envelope writer's rule, verbatim: *a consumer that sees the field renders it verbatim
  and keeps its generic substitution (objectui#3821) for everything unmarked.* The localized
  copy is precisely a generic substitution, and it is currently applied to MARKED bodies too.
- objectstack#8270 (maintainer ruling 2026-08-13) put the localized capability copy there on
  purpose: the door's English sentence was measured verbatim in a zh console, and a
  deployment that withholds the capability does so deliberately, so it must read as a settled
  posture in the user's language. Rendering a marked English sentence there would regress
  that measurement.

A resolution has to choose, per arm, between "the mark outranks the localized posture" and
"the localized posture outranks the mark" — or a third shape (localized copy plus the marked
sentence beneath it). That is a product decision about the ARMS, so objectui#7979 deliberately
left them alone and pinned them as unchanged rather than deciding here.

## Measured, so nobody has to re-derive it

`PackageFormDialog.envelopeUserMessage.test.tsx` (landed with objectui#7979) pins the current
behaviour in its §8 block:

- a 409 carrying `code` + `message` + `userMessage` shows `engine.packages.create.exists`;
- a 403 carrying the same shows `engine.packages.noCapability`;
- with NO status on the error (a transport that drops it), the arms fall back to probing the
  message, that probe now reads whichever prose won, and the marked sentence DOES reach the
  author. So the marked-vs-localized divergence today depends on whether a status survived
  the transport, which is itself an argument for deciding it explicitly.

## Re-check

```
sed -n '/async function submit/,/finally/p' packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx
grep -n "engine.packages.noCapability\|engine.packages.create.exists" -r packages/app-shell/src
```

Related, not duplicates: objectui#7979 (the ladder in this same file), objectui#7959 /
objectui#7938 (the same family upstream of it), objectstack#8270 (the ruling that put the
localized arm there).

Filed by the os-dev seat that implemented objectui#7979, as an out-of-scope finding; no
assignee on purpose. Generated by Claude Code, session `session_01QnpvbdoRisQdRAczkLwnf5`.
